about_the_game:
Somehow, the long thought to be fiction, centuries old warlock, Abaddon, has returned. He has used his powers to create a castle right outside of the town, and is planning an invasion to overthrow the king! It is up to Bojan (against his own will), to explore Abaddon's castle by making his way through 18 rooms while avoiding Abaddon's goblin minions by memorizing their patterns, and battling against 6* bosses all on his own. No weapons, no magic, nothing but Bojan's willpower and smarts will get him through his castle maze. Are you up to the challenge?


The Game

Bojan is a trial and error adventure game that is all about patience. The rooms have goblins who all follow their own patterns, but no two are the same. You must study the way they move in order to walk your way through them to hit all of the colored buttons to turn off the matching colored walls to the exit door.

The Rooms

Each room has its own layout and button placements. As you move through the game, it is good to study the room to see where everything is. Don't take this as you get to sit though, sometimes the goblins meet you right where you start.


Progression

Bojan consists of 18 levels. As you progress, the later rooms will be harder with more buttons than the previous. These are grouped up as sections of the castle by 3 levels and 1 boss. There will be 6* bosses in total after every set of 3 levels.

The Bosses 

If you find that you aren't struggling with the levels, don't hold your breath. The bosses are no joke, and are going to do whatever it takes to stop you in your tracks. Each boss has their own unique attacks and patterns, so keep your guard up!

short_description: You think YOU have it bad? Try getting thrown into a quest with nothing to protect yourself, except your wits! In this trial and error adventure game, patience is key. Explore the castle including 6* bosses and 18 levels complete with their own layouts, enemy paths, buttons, doors and coins!
